name: gatk_omni
description: The 1000 Genomes Omni 2.5 sites of the GATK resource bundle for hg38 (1000G_omni2.5.hg38.vcf.gz), published by the Broad Institute. A truth and training set for SNP variant quality score recalibration.

hg38.naming: UCSC: chr1, chr2, chrX, as in the Broad's Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta. Fits that genome and a UCSC-named GRCh38 analysis set; not an Ensembl or NCBI-named one.
